intro: See something off? RetaBase is community-checked — a quick flag helps us keep it accurate. No account needed, takes a few seconds.
thanks: Thanks — this goes into our review queue. Verified corrections are applied on the next rebuild.

banner.title: Help keep RetaBase accurate
banner.text: This is a community-checked resource. If a paper looks mis-classified, use the ⚑ Report link on its card — it takes a few seconds and directly improves the data for everyone.

points: We record only what you flag: the paper, which aspect looks off, and any note you add. No account or personal information is required.
Reports are grouped by paper and reviewed. Some can be auto-checked against the original source (for example, a paper's PubMed publication type); the rest are flagged for human review.
A reviewer can add a manual override that corrects the automated classification for that paper — human judgment takes precedence over the rule when they disagree.
Verified corrections are applied on the next rebuild and stay auditable in the project's public config.
